expectations.text: Cites the proposed rule: 91 FR 62361, published October 1, 2026, docket DOS-2026-0991
expectations.evidence: "I cannot verify a DDTC 'October 2026 omnibus proposed rule.'" No citation, date, or docket given.

expectations.text: States it would remove and reserve USML Category VIII(h)(10), taking most radar altimeters off the Munitions List
expectations.evidence: Never states the VIII(h)(10) removal; only generic advice to "Look at the parameters for radar altimeters."

expectations.text: Makes clear it is proposed only: current classifications remain in effect until a final rule
expectations.evidence: "A proposed rule changes nothing legally until a final rule is published and takes effect. Until then, current 22 CFR 121.1 controls."

expectations.text: Mentions at least one other element (new 22 CFR 120.35 exclusions section, new 120.41 specially designed releases, or the new 123.26 OEM servicing exemption)
expectations.evidence: None of the new 120.35, new 120.41 releases, or 123.26 exemption is mentioned; only existing definitions and exemptions are referenced generically.

expectations.text: States comments are due November 30, 2026 and advises affected exporters to comment
expectations.evidence: Advises "Submit comments by the deadline" but never states the November 30, 2026 deadline.
